title: Ultra-Realistic iPhone 15 Pro Beach Selfie
summary: Hyper-realistic front-camera selfie of a woman on a bright beach, faithfully replicating iPhone 15 Pro computational photography — wide-angle distortion, pore-level skin detail, and coastal bounce light.
